1.mutant: turns a non-catchable fault into a fabricated catchable Error (single catch point)

why.uncatchable_index.f: array index fault inside try must stay fatal
why.throw_non_error.f: non-Error throw is a malformed-program fault, never caught
why.s13_global_take_index.f: index fault inside a taken global must not be caught; the null-global hazard

2.mutant: leaves a stale handler after break/return (TryEnd does not pop)

why.s08_stale_break_release.f: a break out of a try in a function leaves a stale handler that would catch the caller's unprotected throw

3.mutant: lets the catch binding escape its lexical scope

why.catch_binding_scope.f: the VM must refuse (unresolved-name); the mutant executes the use after catch

4.mutant: restamps the throw site on rethrow (loses the first origin)

why.rethrow_origin.f: rethrows an already-stamped Error; the mutant prints the rethrow location
why.rethrow_origin_cause.f: rethrows a stamped Error with a cause; origin and cause must survive

5.mutant: catches fatal Host errors (ignores the CP16 fatal/recoverable split)

why.c24_sha_dir_fatal.f: sha256_file(directory) is HostStatus::Fatal and must not be caught
why.host_fatal_uncatchable.f: sleep argument error is fatal and must not be caught

why.nested_rethrow.f: inner and outer catches print different messages; inside-out selects inner
why.s22_two_live_handlers.f: two handlers are live at the first throw and their catches print different text

7.mutant: does not restore closure_ after unwinding

why.closure_throw_restore.f: bad captures tag at upvalue 0 and the catcher lists msg at upvalue 0; a stale closure prints after WRONG
why.closure_throw_restore_callvalue.f: the catching frame is a closure reached through CallValue; same wrong-value signal

8.mutant: stamps a shared Error in place (mutates the binding or another reference)

why.p04_same_thrown_twice.f: two throws of the same unoriginated binding must stamp two sites while the binding stays 0:0
why.p05_shared.f: the caught copy has an origin, the shared binding still has 0
why.p14_equality.f: value equality includes the origin; in-place mutation changes comparisons
